svg.title: Most used languages in public repositories
svg.desc: Java 65.5 percent; JavaScript 15.2 percent; TypeScript 7.8 percent; CSS 6.2 percent; HTML 2.2 percent; Python 1.8 percent; SCSS 1.0 percent; Other 0.4 percent. By code bytes, excluding forks and this profile repository. These percentages describe code distribution, not proficiency.

g.aria-label: By code size in public repositories
